"""Independently reread a full Newton enclosure and partition its spectral block."""
import argparse
from fractions import Fraction as F
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def main():
    from flint import arb,arb_mat,ctx
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('report',type=Path)
    p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=p.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():raise FileExistsError('Use a new immutable output path')
    raw=args.report.read_bytes();report=json.loads(raw);r=report['result']
    spec=report['system_enclosures'];path=Path(spec['path'])
    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=spec['sha256']:raise ValueError('System hash mismatch')
    system=json.load(gzip.open(path,'rt'));seed=json.loads(Path(report['seed_path']).read_text())
    if hashlib.sha256(Path(report['seed_path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=report['seed_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Seed hash mismatch')
    source=json.loads(Path(seed['source_seed']).read_text())
    rho=next(v for v in source['original_variable_map'] if v['name']=='rho_over_k_squared')
    free=r['equality']['free_columns']
    selected=[i for i,j in enumerate(free) if rho['offset']<=seed['current_to_original_columns'][j]<rho['offset']+rho['size']]
    old=ctx.prec
    try:
        ctx.prec=320
        def ball(q):q=F(q);return arb(q.numerator)/q.denominator
        def enclosure(bounds):
            lo,hi=map(F,bounds)
            if lo>hi:raise ValueError('Reversed interval')
            return ball((lo+hi)/2)+arb(0,ball((hi-lo)/2).upper())
        def interval(v):return dict(lower=str(v.lower().fmpq()),upper=str(v.upper().fmpq()),ball=str(v))
        n=system['dimension'];H=arb_mat(n,n);k=0
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i+1):H[i,j]=H[j,i]=enclosure(system['Hessian_lower_triangle_bounds'][k]);k+=1
        g=arb_mat([[enclosure(v)] for v in system['gradient_bounds']])
        direction=arb_mat([[enclosure([v['lower_rational'],v['upper_rational']])] for v in r['free_direction_enclosures']])
        residual=H*direction+g;lam=-(g.transpose()*direction)[0,0]
        Hrr=arb_mat([[H[i,j] for j in selected] for i in selected]);gr=arb_mat([[g[i,0]] for i in selected])
        conditional=(gr.transpose()*Hrr.solve(gr))[0,0]
        remaining=lam-conditional
        out=dict(report=str(args.report),report_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            system_path=str(path),system_sha256=spec['sha256'],precision_bits=320,dimension=n,
            Newton_residual_all_components_contain_zero=all(residual[i,0].contains(0) for i in range(n)),
            Newton_residual_infinity_upper=str(max(abs(residual[i,0]).upper() for i in range(n)).fmpq()),
            independently_recomputed_lambda_squared=interval(lam),spectral_free_coordinate_count=len(selected),
            spectral_conditional_decrement_squared=interval(conditional),
            remaining_Schur_complement_decrement_squared=interval(remaining),
            spectral_fraction_of_full_decrement=interval(conditional/lam),
            identity='lambda²=g_rho.T H_rhorho^-1 g_rho + g_reduced.T H_Schur^-1 g_reduced',
            scope='Independent arithmetic on the complete archived interval system, not an independent reconstruction of physical projection operators. No primal point moved.',
            script_source_utf8=Path(__file__).read_text())
        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['script_source_utf8','Newton_residual_infinity_upper']}),flush=True)
    finally:ctx.prec=old


if __name__=='__main__':main()
